user.title: Time settings
user.description: Choose how each anchor of the night period is determined and which features are enabled. Only relevant fields are shown on the next page.

data.day_enabled: Apply daytime settings after night ends

time_details.title: Time details
time_details.description: Only fields relevant to your choices are shown. Transition duration 0 = instant switch.

data.sun_entity: Sun entity (default: built-in sun.sun; custom entities need next_rising / next_setting attributes)

extra_period.title: Extra period ({position})
extra_period.description: An extra period is a single anchor time: its parameters apply from the start time until the next anchor (e.g. night start).

lights_extra.title: Per-light extra settings
lights_extra.description:
Enable custom parameters per light. Only enabled lights get their own settings page.

{lights}

data.turn_on_listen: Apply settings when a light turns on
data.only_when_on: Only adjust lights that are already on

per_light.title: Per-light override ({position})
per_light.description: Light: {name} (`{entity}`). Set custom parameters for this light, replacing the global values. Fields: night, daytime (if enabled), then one brightness/color-temperature pair per extra period (extra_0 = period 1, etc.).
